newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says rebel Kurds kill 17 in bus attack.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says rebel Kurds kill 17 in bus attack.

text.p: Kurdish guerrillas killed 17 people, including 12 members of an anti-rebel village militia, in an attack on a minibus on Friday in southeast Turkey, the emergency rule governor's office in Diyarbakir said.
In a statement, the governor's office also said security forces had killed 22 Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels in separate clashes in the region, where the rebels are fighting for self-rule.
It did not say when the clashes took place.

The statement said PKK guerrillas attacked the vehicle in the southeastern province of Hakkari, near the mountainous border with Iraq, killing 12 state-armed village guards and five civilians, including a woman and two children.
Turkish troops killed almost 30 guerrillas in three days of operations on the border earlier this week.
More than 21,000 people have died in 12 years of clashes between security forces and the PKK, fighting for Kurdish self-rule in southeast Turkey.
